quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: After months of putting it off, Renata finally organized her cluttered closet over the weekend. She donated three full bags of clothes she no longer wore.
quests.hint: Find how many bags of clothes Renata donated.
quests.explanation: The passage says she donated three bags, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Admittedly, because the online exam platform crashed twice during finals week, the university extended the testing window by an extra two days.
quests.hint: Find what happened twice to the exam platform.
quests.explanation: The passage says the platform crashed, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the company relocated its headquarters downtown, several employees now take the subway instead of driving to work.
quests.hint: Find what several employees now take to work.
quests.explanation: The passage says they take the subway, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the volcano showed signs of activity, park officials temporarily closed the summit trail to all hikers.

quests.explanation: The passage says the volcano showed activity, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Revealingly, because her older sister moved out for university, Zara finally has a bedroom entirely to herself for the first time.

quests.explanation: The passage says she has a bedroom to herself, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the store's return policy changed recently, customers now have sixty days instead of thirty to bring items back.

quests.explanation: The passage says customers now have sixty days, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because fresh seafood is delivered every Tuesday, the small restaurant changes part of its menu weekly to match the catch.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Unsurprisingly, because the app kept draining her phone's battery overnight, Sofia finally uninstalled it and switched to an alternative.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.explanation: The passage says he scheduled with an allergist, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the small theater only seats eighty people, tickets for the weekend play sell out almost immediately.
quests.hint: Find how many people the small theater seats.
quests.explanation: The passage says it seats eighty people, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Notably, because beavers had built a dam across the stream, the surrounding area slowly turned into a small wetland.

quests.explanation: The passage says beavers built the dam, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because vandalism had increased near the park, the city installed brighter lighting along the main walking path.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.explanation: The passage says the man feeds pigeons, so that is correct.

quests.passage: Interestingly, after struggling through his first semester of statistics, Marcus finally found a tutor who explained concepts using real-world examples instead of formulas alone.

quests.explanation: The passage says he found a tutor, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: After receiving several complaints about noise, the office finally installed sound-absorbing panels throughout the open workspace.
quests.hint: Find what the office finally installed.
quests.explanation: The passage says they installed sound-absorbing panels, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: After missing their connecting flight by only minutes, the couple spent an unplanned night at the airport hotel.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
